before: Suggesting mode deleted a whole table with an untracked deleteBlock, selectTableRegion was refused, and no op moved a table.
after: Suggesting mode refuses whole-table deletion and moves, and strikes the cell text of tables a range encloses. selectTableRegion selects every cell of a table, Backspace on that selection deletes the table, and the new moveTable op reorders a table among its siblings with every node id kept.
reason: moveTable journals as one moveNode effect through the new moveChild edit helper, so the shared list never holds the table twice and a peer's concurrent text inside the table survives. Other edits use existing operations. Selection is local state. No shared field, schema or package serialization changes.
